label: prf:non-self-intersection
title: Proof of Obstruction to self-intersection
html:
The mechanism is as follows. The universal R-matrix \mathcal{R} \in \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) \hat{\otimes} \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) (Remark) controls the failure of the cocommutativity square

  \sigma \circ \Delta  \neq  \Delta,

where \sigma is the tensor swap. At q = 1 one has \mathcal{R} = 1 \otimes 1 and the comultiplication is cocommutative, so strands may pass through each other freely (the "classical" regime where self-intersection is not penalised by the energy functional).

For q \neq 1, by (q-deformed kernel with hard singularity), the classical 1/r^2 repulsion kernel is replaced by [2]_q / (\lvert \varrho(s) - \varrho(t) \rvert^2 - \hbar_q^2), which has a hard singularity at \lvert \varrho(s) - \varrho(t) \rvert = \hbar_q, creating an energy barrier of infinite height at the quantum scale. \square
